name: claude-cli-proxied-checkout
description: Real lab run, 2026-11-13: Claude (CLI) driving Chrome through a full purchase to the Stripe test payment, through the operator's own TLS-terminating reverse proxy. Caught by behaviour alone: tab hidden while driven, jump clicks, dead-centre clicks, fields set by script, think-then-act pauses. Must stay 'AI agent'.
